packet_grouping_guard: checkpoint retains collected canonical rows and coefficients but not packet labels; only the grouped six-ID scalar is source-faithful
compression_proof: literal K16 row and p1 are expanded through every K3 tail before p2; only the terminal K2 response is cached by (profile,literal signature,p2,degree), after the last pivot decision
sign_rule: stored v is the direct coefficient in P; two normalized response sign flips give +v/(m1*m2)
scope: exactly the grouped six requested K21 IDs; no individual reconstruction, other K21 ID, row checkpoint, or membership inference
